A reaction, or a note about what went wrong, on one of the harness's messages.

**Direction:** Chips → Harness  
**Sent by:** a person  
**Requires a run:** no  
**Schema:** [`feedback.json`](/schema/feedback.json)

## Fields

Every event also carries the [envelope](/reference/envelope/).

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v` | yes | `1` | Protocol major version. |
| `type` | yes | `"feedback"` |  |
| `id` | yes | `string` | The event's own id. Stable across a retry of the same event. |
| `ts` | yes | `string` | When it happened, by Chips' clock. Stamped on the way in; a value the sender writes is replaced. |
| `workspace_id` | yes | `string` | A workspace identifier: `ws_` followed by a ULID. |
| `space_id` | no | `string` | The space, when the event belongs to one. |
| `run_id` | no | `string` | The run, when the event belongs to one. |
| `seq` | no | `number` | Assigned by the server on append, monotonic per workspace. Absent on the way in. |
| `idempotency_key` | no | `string` | Required on every client-originated write. Sending the same key twice is a no-op. |
| `actor` | yes | object | The participant an event is attributed to. |
| `actor.kind` | yes | `"person" \| "harness" \| "agent" \| "system"` | Whether a person, a harness, one of a harness's agents or Chips itself acted. |
| `actor.id` | yes | `string` | The participant id, or `system` for Chips. |
| `actor.harness_id` | no | `string` | For an agent: the harness it speaks through, whose budget and runs are the agent's (ADR 0087). Filled in by Chips. |
| `message_id` | yes | `string` | The message it is about: one a harness said, in the space the event names. |
| `kind` | yes | `"reaction" \| "correction"` | A light signal, or a written note. |
| `reaction` | no | `string` | The emoji, when the kind is `reaction`. Required then. |
| `text` | no | `string` | What went wrong, when the kind is `correction`. Required then. |
| `from` | yes | object | Who gave it. Filled in by Chips from the credential and the membership; a value the sender writes is replaced. |
| `from.participant_id` | yes | `string` | The stable id of the sender. |
| `from.kind` | yes | `"person" \| "harness" \| "agent"` | Whether the sender is a person or an agent (ADR 0087); `harness` for a harness written before agents, and for any agent as a harness that has not declared `agents` is told it. |
| `from.display_name` | yes | `string` | The name to show. |
| `from.role` | yes | `"owner" \| "member" \| "guest"` | The sender's standing in this space. Multi-user is Chips' job, not the harness's. |
| `from.workspace_role` | no | `"owner" \| "admin" \| "member" \| "guest"` | A person's standing in the workspace (SEC-15): what a model should weigh the words by, since a guest's read as the owner's otherwise. `promptFor` says it after the name. Absent for an agent or a harness, and from a Chips before it said. |

## Example

```json
{
  "v": 1,
  "type": "feedback",
  "id": "evt_01K4ZQPX00000000000000007F",
  "ts": "2026-09-02T14:22:27.004Z",
  "workspace_id": "ws_01K4ZQPX000000000000000001",
  "space_id": "spc_01K4ZQPX000000000000000002",
  "actor": {
    "kind": "person",
    "id": "usr_01K4ZQPX000000000000000003"
  },
  "message_id": "msg_01K4ZQPX000000000000000067",
  "kind": "correction",
  "text": "The delivery date is the 19th, not the 12th.",
  "from": {
    "participant_id": "usr_01K4ZQPX000000000000000003",
    "kind": "person",
    "display_name": "Arjun",
    "role": "owner"
  }
}
```
